name: Jehiel
overview: Jehiel is a name associated with several Levites and priests in Scripture, reflecting various roles within the community of Israel. He is identified as the father of Obadiah and Shechaniah, both of whom are mentioned in the context of Ezra's time, with Shechaniah notably acknowledging Israel's sin in marrying foreign wives yet expressing hope for repentance. Jehiel is listed among the sons of Harim and Elam, indicating his Levitical lineage and involvement in the post-exilic restoration of worship and community purity.
